segments.text: A first-year student who enrolled at Amatsuchi Academy this spring.

She belongs to the Idol Club, which is directly under the authority of the Amatsuchi Academy Public Relations Bureau. The Idol Club has the role of promoting and communicating the appeal of Amatsuchi to the world. It is precisely the academy's star attraction, a presence that is always drawing attention from all over the world! ...Or at least, it should be.

Her personal channel is devastatingly unpopular. Her own attitude is disastrous as well. Rather than idol activities, she does not even try to actively associate with anyone in her private life. Or rather, she gives equally cold treatment to absolutely everyone. Naturally, the protagonist, who has somehow been made her manager, is no exception. She treats him as an enemy as well.

Her special talent is eating large amounts of food, and her hobby is eating. Somehow, she continues being an idol by relying on her mysterious beauty. Although not widely known, she is actually a good singer as well. If you make a tsukkomi, you lose.
この春、アマツチ学園に入学した一年生。
アマツチ学園広報局直轄、アイドル部に所属している。
アイドル部とは世界に向けてアマツチの魅力を広報・発信する役割を持つ。
まさに学園の花形、常に世界中の注目を集める存在！
……のはずが、個人チャンネルは破壊的に人気がない。
本人の姿勢も惨たるもので、アイドル活動どころか、プライベートでも誰とも積極的に関わろうともしない。
というかまんべんなく、誰に対しても塩対応。
なぜか彼女のマネージャー担当にさせられた主人公も当然、目の敵に。
特技は大食いで趣味は食べること。
神秘の美貌を武器になんとかアイドルは続けている。
あまり知られていないが、実は歌も上手い。
ツッコんだら負けである。

segments.text: A second-year student at Amatsuchi Academy. Her family is among the wealthiest in the world. She calls herself the "Shining Alber."

Last year, she enrolled at Amatsuchi Academy together with Patricia and, at the same time, joined the Ruins Exploration Club. Using the power of money, she recruited capable adventurers one after another, and in the span of just one year, grew her own guild, the "Lisette Paladin Order," into one of the academy's foremost organizations.
She openly declares that she will "completely conquer Amatsuchi," and diligently faces her daily adventures.

Her personality is the complete opposite of rough or uncouth, possessing a refinement one would not expect from an adventurer. She almost never behaves arrogantly (meaning: she does, once in a while). Rather, she is charming in a puppy-like way. As for herself, she is of absolutely no use in adventures.
The protagonist, who possesses an unusual background and is highly skilled with the sword, naturally ends up attracting her interest.
アマツチ学園に通う二年生。
実家は世界でも屈指の富豪。自称・輝けるアルベール。
昨年、パトリシアを伴ってアマツチ学園に入学と同時に遺跡調査部に参加。
金の暴力で有能な冒険者を根こそぎスカウトし、僅か一年で自らのギルド『リゼット聖騎士団』を学園屈指の組織に成長させた。
「アマツチの完全踏破」を公言する彼女は、勤勉に日々の冒険に臨んでいる。
その性格は粗野の真逆で、冒険者らしからぬ品格の持ち主。
高慢な振る舞いもほとんどない(たまにはあるの意)。
むしろ、子犬的な愛嬌があるくらい。
自身は冒険では一切の役に立たない。
特殊な経歴の持ち主で剣の腕が立つ主人公は、当然のように彼女の関心を引いてしまうことに。

A third-year student at Amatsuchi Academy. She is the sole club president of the Adventure Club, an organization that keeps itself separate from the Ruins Exploration Club, the mainstream of adventurers. She is the symbolic figure of the club, possessing countless legendary, outrageous stories. Incidentally, every single one of those outrageous stories (abbreviated as mucha-epi) is true.

Possessing both abundant experience and ability, she is the current No. 1 adventurer. Since she is outrageous and completely over-the-top in all sorts of ways, she is feared even by her fellow adventurers. She's a giant "swelling" that nobody wants to touch.
She is almost never seen in the academy buildings. For that matter, she hardly even returns to the mainland on the opposite side of the island.

A creature that travels back and forth between Amatsuchi, the Adventure Club's clubroom, and the tavern. The driving force behind her is her infinite love for Amatsuchi. In short, she is severely addicted to adventuring. Naturally, she's completely beyond help. Originally, there should have been no reason whatsoever for the protagonist, a novice adventurer, to have any connection with her... (presses palms together)
アマツチ学園の三年生。
冒険者のメインストリーム、遺跡調査部とは一線を引いた組織、冒険部のひとり部長。
伝説級のむちゃくちゃなエピソードを数多く持つ、この部の象徴的な存在。
なお、むちゃエピ(略)の全ては実話である。
豊富な経験と実力を兼ね備えた、現役Ｎｏ．１の冒険者。
色々、はちゃめちゃでむちゃくちゃなので同じ冒険者達からも恐れられている。
誰も関わろうとしない、でっかい腫れ物。
ほとんど学園の校舎で見かけることはないし、なんなら島の対岸の本土にもロクに帰ってない。
アマツチと冒険部の部室と酒場の間を行き来する生き物。
その原動力はアマツチへの無限の愛。
要するに重度の冒険中毒である。もちろん、手の施しようはない。
本来、駆け出し冒険者の主人公と接点が生じるはずはないのだが……(合掌)。

A mysterious golem excavated from the depths of Amatsuchi by adventurers. As far as her status is concerned, she is, for the time being, a student at the academy. Everyone calls her "Golem-chan." That's exactly what she is. Her name was given to her by the adventurer who excavated her.
She has no memories from before awakening in this era. She is an utterly good-hearted girl, kind to a fault and easily pressured.

As the ace of Sentinel, the academy's security organization (something like a vigilante corps), she protects the peace of the academy day after day. Her main job is to pyuun over whenever a reckless adventurer gets into trouble. In fact, there are countless adventurers whose lives she has saved. Her saintly conduct and shining goodness are enough to tame even the most scumbag adventurers (without her realizing it).

Contrary to her appearance, she is incredibly strong. She can also pyuu~n through the sky, and even fires beam-like attacks. Overall, she is on an entirely different scale of strength from ordinary adventurers.
アマツチの深部で冒険者の手によって発掘された、神秘のゴーレム。
立場としては一応学園の生徒。
人呼んでみんなのゴーレムちゃん。そのままである。
名前は彼女を発掘した冒険者がつけた。
この時代に覚醒する以前の記憶は持っていない。
とても心優しくて押しに弱い、完全無欠のいい子。
学園の保安組織(自警団みたいなもの)・センチネルのエースとして、日々、学園の平和を守ってる。
主な仕事は無謀な冒険者がピンチになったら、ぴゅーんと駆けつけること。
実際、命を救われた冒険者は数知れず。
聖人的な日々の行いと輝ける善性は、多くのクズ冒険者をも手懐けるほど(自覚なし)。
見た目とは裏腹に超強いし、ぴゅーんと空も飛ぶし、ビームみたいなのも撃つ。
総じて、一般冒険者とは強さの規格が違う。

A first-year student who transferred into Amatsuchi Academy during this awkward time of year that can be called neither spring nor summer. (Although he himself isn't very aware of it, accepting a transfer student is an exception among exceptions, the first since Amatsuchi Academy was founded.)

Until this spring, he lived in Tokyo, Japan. Both of his parents were involved in the investigation of Amatsuchi, while he himself was born in Yozuha. When he was young, he lost his parents in an accident while they were investigating Amatsuchi, and was taken in by his grandmother (his father's mother), who lived in Tokyo, so he has no memories of that time. Because of those circumstances, he doesn't have a very good impression of Amatsuchi.

His family has run a swordsmanship dojo for generations, and his father also made use of those skills while active in Amatsuchi. He himself is also highly skilled with the sword (his grandmother was his teacher). Since he is fundamentally and decisively out of sync with the seasoned adventurers, he is often teased and messed with.
Although highly skilled with the sword, he's generally ill-fated, and just a little unfortunate.
春とも夏ともいえない中途半端なこの時期に、アマツチ学園に編入してきた一年生。
(本人はあまり自覚はないが、編入の受け入れは異例中の異例でアマツチ学園創設以来初のこと)
本作の主人公。
この春までは日本の東京で暮らしていた。
両親ともにアマツチの調査に携わっていて、彼自身はヨヅハ産まれ。
幼い頃にアマツチを調査中の事故で両親を失い、東京で暮らす祖母(父方)に引き取られたので当時の記憶はない。
そんな経緯もあって、アマツチにあまりいい印象は持っていない。
実家は先祖代々の剣術道場で、父もそのスキルを活かしてアマツチで活躍していた。
本人も剣術の腕はかなりのもの(師匠は祖母)。
こなれた冒険者達とは決定的にノリがあわないので、よくいじられたりからわかれたりしている。
剣の腕は立つが全体的に幸が薄く、ほんのりと不遇。

A second-year student at Amatsuchi Academy. She came to Amatsuchi Academy together with Lisette Albert, having been employed by her. Her actual age is a little older than Lisette's.

She has accumulated a fair amount of experience as a working adult (including in rough work), and is well versed in handling firearms, combat, and commanding a group. (Incidentally, under Yozuha's laws, firearms are legal "only for use within the ruins.") She is recognized by everyone as the de facto commander of the Lisette Paladin Order.
"Run away and I'll kill you. Betray us and I'll kill you. Start flirting, and of course I'll kill you."

The rules of the Order that she decided on by herself are practically on the level of the Shinsen●. Combined with her cool demeanor, she tends to give those around her the impression of being cold-hearted, but she is held in high esteem within the Order.

Aside from activities with the Order, she doesn't socialize with anyone, but she is basically always together with Lisette. She's also the bodyguard of the conspicuous, hopelessly incompetent Lisette, and that's actually her main job.
アマツチ学園に通う二年生。
リゼット=アルベールに雇用される形で、共にアマツチ学園にやってきた。
実年齢はリゼットよりちょっと上。
それなりに（荒事も含めた）社会人経験を積んでおり、火器の扱いや戦闘、団の指揮に精通している。
(なお、ヨヅハの法律において火器は「遺跡内での使用に限り」合法)
誰もが認める、『リゼット聖騎士団』の実質の指揮官。
「逃げたら殺す、裏切ったら殺す、イチャついたらもちろん殺す」
彼女が独断で決めた団の規則はほとんど新選●の域。
クールな振る舞いもあって冷酷な印象を周囲に与えがちだが、団での信望は厚い。
団での活動を除いて誰かと馴れ合うようなことはないが、基本的にリゼットとは行動を共にしている。
目立つ存在でポンコツなリゼットの護衛でもあり、そっちが主な仕事なので。

One of the academy's old-timers, and by now a highest-year student for the ●th time.

She never appears to be active as an adventurer, but she is extraordinarily knowledgeable about all sorts of things related to the ruins. For the time being, she is the sole club president of the Gourmet Club, whose motto is to serve dishes made using only ingredients originating from Amatsuchi. Dragon Steak, the restaurant she runs, is always bustling with adventurers. (The restaurant's name comes from her wish to "someday try cooking a dragon.")

Everyone's dependable older sister. In fact, she takes very good care of others. The fact that she treats the solitary No. 1 adventurer, Nanami Nagi, like an underling alone shows just how unfathomable she is.

Her hobby is cooking, and her specialty is cooking as well. She is extremely serious about cooking, and the ingredients change drastically depending on what comes in that day. As a result, the dishes she serves have quite a wide range of outcomes (← a gently worded warning). She may seem like a gentle, easygoing older sister, but when it comes to cooking, she is extremely forceful, so caution is advised.
学園の生徒としては古株で、最上級生もはや●回目。
冒険者として活動している様子こそ見せないが、異常なまでに遺跡のあれこれに精通している。
一応、アマツチ由来の食品のみで料理を提供することをモットーとする美食部のひとり部長。
彼女が切り盛りする『ドラゴンステーキ』は常に冒険者で賑わっている。
（店名の由来は「いつかドラゴンを調理してみたい」という彼女の願いから）
みんなの頼れるお姉さん。実際、面倒見はかなりいい。
孤高の存在であるＮｏ.１冒険者・七海凪を子分的に扱っているだけでも底知れない。
趣味は料理、特技も料理。
料理にあまりにもガチである上、食材はその日の仕入れで大きく変わる。
そのため、提供される料理はかなり振れ幅が大きい（←やんわりとした警告表現）。
おっとりお姉さんのようで、料理に関する押しはゴリゴリに強いので注意が必要。

A second-year student who belongs to the Newspaper Club.

Originally, the Newspaper Club is a peaceful and tranquil organization directly under the Public Relations Bureau, but she's an outlier... or rather, something like that. With the goal of "exposing the dark side of Amatsuchi Academy," she spends her days pursuing suspicious activities. Her basic stance is essentially, "If it's something that can be used to bash the higher-ups, anything goes." In fact, she's covered everything from corruption, to suspicious flows of money, to eyewitness accounts of aliens—her repertoire is extensive.

Her current favorite is the theory that "Yozuha is being controlled by aliens through Amatsuchi." Since she's completely serious about it, that only makes her even more... (omitted). Perhaps because there are quite a few people around the world who resonate with her, the channel she streams on by herself is extremely popular. Reckless reporting, trouble with adventurers, outrageous theories built on nothing but speculation... Thanks to one screw-up after another, she's constantly under the watchful eye of the academy's higher-ups, but she doesn't pay it any mind.
Even the other members of the Newspaper Club, her own colleagues, have resigned themselves to the idea that she'll probably be expelled before long.
新聞部に所属する一年生。
本来、新聞部は広報局直轄の平和で平穏な組織だが、彼女は異端というかなんというか。
「アマツチ学園の暗部を暴く」と志を掲げ、疑惑の追求に日々明け暮れている。
基本スタンスは上層部を叩けるネタならなんでも、って感じ。
実際、汚職だの不自然な金の流れだの、宇宙人の目撃証言だの、手数は多い。
最近のお気に入りは「ヨヅハはアマツチ経由で宇宙人に支配されてる」説。
本人は大真面なので、なおさら性質が（略）。
共鳴する人も世界規模ではそれなりに多いのか、彼女が個人で配信しているチャンネルは大好評。
無茶な取材や冒険者とのトラブル、憶測ベースのトンデモな持論展開……。
数々のやらかしで学園の上層部から睨まれまくっているが、本人は気にも留めていない。
そろそろ退学だろうと、同僚である新聞部の面々すら諦めている。

The Head of State of the Republic of Yozuha, and the headmaster of Amatsuchi Academy.
...Or so it is said (at first glance), a beautiful girl. Her background and appearance don't match at all, so the protagonist suspects the possibility that she's a body double.

She also seems to have had some connection with the protagonist's missing parents, but she continually evades explaining that matter. More of an adult than any other adult, and possessing more mysteries than anyone else.

Publicly, the Head of State of Yozuha is regarded as an unknown figure, and there are very few people who know what she looks like. Around the protagonist, Takamori is about the only one. Besides assigning Takamori to the protagonist as his guide around Amatsuchi, she also helps smooth the way for his new life at the academy in all sorts of ways.
ヨヅハ共和国の国家元首にして、アマツチ学園の学園長。
……ということになっている(ぱっと見)美少女。
とても経歴と外見が一致しないので、主人公は影武者の可能性を疑っている。
失踪した主人公の両親とも関りがあったようだが、その辺りの説明はのらりくらり。
どんな大人よりも大人で、誰よりも謎が多い。
公にヨヅハの国家元首は正体不明で通っており、その姿を知る者は数少ない。
主人公の周りではタカモリくらい。
そのタカモリをアマツチのガイド役として主人公に差し向けた他、何かと彼の新しい学園生活に便宜を図ってくれる。

A mysterious creature that pokon-ed out of a mysterious egg discovered in the depths of Amatsuchi. His first-person pronoun is oidon, and he ends every sentence with -gowasu. He loves his friends, protects the weak, and cannot tolerate injustice, a man among men (at least in spirit). A fair amount of time has passed since he hatched from the egg, but at the very least, there has been no visible growth in his appearance.

He was sent to serve as the protagonist's guide, and is currently living and eating together with him. He isn't of much use, but one way or another, he and the protagonist have developed a friendship.
アマツチの深層で発見された謎の卵から、ポコンと産まれてきた不思議生物。
一人称はおいどんで、語尾はごわす。
友を愛し弱きを守り、曲がったことは許せない、漢の中の漢（気持ちの上では）。
卵から孵ってからそれなりに年月は経っているが、少なくとも外見に成長は見られない。
主人公のガイド役として派遣されてきて、現在は寝食を共にしている。
あまり役には立たないが、なんだかんだ主人公とは友情を育んでいる。

A second-year student at the academy. His real name is Udatsu Mahiro, but nobody calls him that. Almost everyone who knows him calls him things like "Scumbag" or "Trash." That's the kind of person he is.

His ability as an adventurer is decent enough, and he's also highly knowledgeable, but since all he ever thinks about is using other people, he usually fails and then runs away from the responsibility. He doesn't have a redeeming side, a tragic past, or anything like that whatsoever. He’s just a pure, unadulterated scumbag (spoilers).
学園の二年生。本名は鵜立真尋だが、誰も呼ばない。
ほとんどの面識がある人にはカスとかゴミとか呼ばれてる、そんな人。
色々やらかしているせいで、現在冒険者ライセンスは停止中。
冒険者としての腕はそれなりで知識も豊富だが、他人を利用することしか考えてないので、大抵失敗するし責任から逃げる。
憎めない一面とか悲しい過去とかそういうのも一切ない、純度の高いクズである（ネタバレ）。
